Introduction

Shohei is a Japanese singer and rapper under SM Entertainment. He is a member of the trot-idol group MYTRO.

He was introduced to the public, as a member of the trainee team SM Rookies, on July 2, 2022 alongside Eunseok and Seunghan. Although Shohei was initially slated to join NCT New Team, he was unable to do so due to a severe back injury in May 2023. However, SM Entertainment clarified that he remained with the company and has plans for future solo activities.
